children: Private equity firm GTCR and activist investor Elliott Investment Management are in advanced talks to acquire software provider CCC Intelligent Solutions
, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Shares of the company, which provides software that helps auto insurers, repair shops, automakers and parts suppliers manage operations, rose about 11% in extended trading.
A deal could be announced as soon as next week, however, a final agreement had not been reached, the report said, without disclosing financial details
CCC, Elliott and GTCR did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment
Bloomberg News had reported in August that online vehicle auctioneer Copart
was in talks to acquire CCC

In July, Reuters had reported that CCC was exploring a sale and that the Chicago-based company had hired Morgan Stanley to advise on the process and reached out to potential buyers, including private equity firms

Advent International, which acquired CCC in 2017 and took the company public through a merger with a special-purpose acquisition company in 2021, exited its investment in 2025 through a series of secondary share offerings, including the sale of its remaining stake
